x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, decision 403. A voting round names the meeting it was opened in, so a rule that holds per meeting can find every round of that meeting. The per-holder proxy cap (decidiq/max_proxies_per_holder) counts a holder's proxies across all rounds of the meeting, as the voting-system spec says; a round without a meeting is counted on its own.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting this voting round was opened in.
meeting.x-notes: Set by VotingRoundOpener from the meeting the round is opened for, and never changed afterwards. Empty on rounds opened before the field existed; ProxyDelegationService then counts the proxy cap on the round alone.
